name: Lifeguard Training (Charlottesville Parks and Recreation)
org: City of Charlottesville Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: This is a lifeguard certification class. The city's aquatics staff runs it. You must pass an in-water pretest. You finish online assignments. You attend in-class sessions.
who_can_apply: Listed for ages 15 and up. Everyone must pass the in-water pretest or be removed from the class.
pay_detail: Course fee not stated on the page (an optional CPR mask is $15).
deadline_text: Session dates were not listed on the page; use the Registration & Tickets link.
how_to_apply: Register through the city's Registration & Tickets system. Within 72 hours of registering, email swimprograms@charlottesville.gov with the subject Lifeguard Pretest to book the pretest at least 8 days ahead.
notes: The page does not say the class leads to a job. The city lists seasonal and variable-hour jobs on governmentjobs.com; none were open on 2026-10-09. Virginia's labor department says 14 and 15 year old workers need an Employment Certificate before any work.
